introHtml: Green flashing blinky lights offer high visibility for safety vests, event giveaways, or nighttime promotions. Unlike standard colors, green stands out in low-light environments and is often preferred for safety applications or themed campaigns. These compact lights clip onto bags, belts, or lanyards, making them practical for trade shows, parades, or construction sites. Decorate with your logo via pad printing for effective brand exposure.
